comparison.objective: Release a hot air-fryer basket, lift it from its drawer, and place it on a mat; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a release button while extracting a nested basket by its handle versus fine hex/collar manipulation and dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Basket on mat, button returned, stable and released, with no hot-surface contact; candidate uses travel, force, energy, rebound, and drift gates.
comparison.reason: Release-and-extract handling does not test adjustment or dynamic energy absorption.
